title: The Pinochet File: A Declassified Dossier on Atrocity and Accountability
publisher_or_archive: The New Press / National Security Archive
summary: Compendium and analysis of thousands of declassified CIA, State Department, White House, and Defense Department documents detailing direct US covert involvement in the destabilization of Chile, support for Pinochet's military dictatorship, and knowledge of Operation Condor transnational assassination squads.
